note: A made-up brand for trying the system out. Fonts are Avenir Next, which ships with every Mac, so nothing needs installing. Copy this file to brands/<your-brand>.json and change the fonts (PostScript names, as listed in Font Book > Info) and colours. No pictogramSet: icons are the built-in drawn glyphs. No logo: the stage draws a LOGO placeholder box; set "logo" to an absolute path to a PNG to use a real one. For instructional films also set plan.fonts.black / plan.fonts.xbold in the plan (see briefs/demo/instructional/demo.plan.json).
